intro: Over the past three weeks, ZCyberNews has published 10 articles tagged with evasion, covering incidents from April 12 to May 4, 2026. The coverage includes 8 high-severity and 2 medium-severity events. Threat actors Payouts King and The Gentlemen were observed in these reports. Affected sectors include financial services, healthcare, multiple, and technology, while impacted regions are the Czech Republic, the EU, and North America.
